CURAA.NS.d: Cura Technologies Ltd. is a Hyderabad-based Indian IT company, founded in 1991 as Softpro Systems Ltd and renamed in October 2010. It offers custom software development, IT-enabled services and e-CRM solutions for customer acquisition and retention, including call centers and transcription, plus BPO, back-office operations, application development and network management support.

DCAL.NS.d: Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited provides contract research and manufacturing services to the pharmaceutical industry worldwide. It also manufactures and supplies marketable molecules, such as bulk drugs, intermediates, quaternary ammonium compounds, specialty chemicals, vitamins and chemicals, and disinfectants. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India. Dishman Carbogen Amcis Limited is a subsidiary of Adimans Technologies LLP.

DUGLOBAL.NS.d: Dudigital Global Ltd. is an India-based company operating in the digital services and technology sector, specializing as an outsourcing and technology solutions provider for governments and diplomatic missions globally. The company primarily offers visa processing services, including visa application handling, biometric data collection, document verification, and consular services. It also provides passport services, e-visa solutions, identity management, and various citizen services.

EASTSILK.NS.d: Eastern Silk Industries Limited manufactures and sells textile and allied products in India. It provides silk yarns, fabrics and made-ups, home furnishings, scarves, laces, and belts, as well as fashion, handloom, embroidered, and double width fabrics. The company also exports its products to the United States, Europe, Australia, the Middle East, Canada, Japan, New Zealand, Scandinavian, and EFFTA countries. Eastern Silk Industries Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Kolkata, India.

ENFUSE.NS.d: Enfuse Solutions Ltd. operates as an information technology consulting and services company, primarily focusing on providing integrated digital solutions globally. The company's core services encompass data management and analytics, including data processing, quality improvement, engineering, annotation, and master data management, alongside e-commerce and digital services such as platform development, content management, and digital marketing.

GSFC.NS.d: Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells fertilizers and industrial products in India. The company offers industrial products, such as anhydrous ammonia, argon gas, caprolactam, melamine, methanol, methyl ethyl ketoxime, nylon-6 chips, oleum, sulphuric acid, acetone cyanohydrine, anone-anol mixture, cyclohexane, cyclohexanone, hydroxylamine sulphate, methacrylic acid, methyl methacrylate, nitric acid, nylon-6 filament yarns, polymethyl methacrylate, GUJCON CRF and PRF polyamide-6…

GYFTR.NS.d: Gyftr Limited is an Indian financial services company providing a range of services including broking, wealth management, and investment banking. The company offers trading and investment solutions across various asset classes to retail and institutional clients. Gyftr Limited is based in Mumbai, India.

HAVELLS.NS.d: Havells India Limited, a fast moving electrical goods company, manufactures, sells, and exports industrial and consumer electrical products in India and internationally. It operates through five segments: Switchgears, Cables, Lighting and Fixtures, Electrical Consumer Durables, and Lloyd Consumer.

HINDPETRO.NS.d: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited refines and markets petroleum products in India and internationally. The company operates through Downstream Petroleum and Others segments.

HPIL.NS.d: Hindprakash Industries Ltd. makes and trades dyes, auxiliaries, intermediates and chemicals, producing reactive and disperse dyes plus auxiliaries for the domestic textile industry. Its products also include water treatment items. Tejmalji Mangal founded it in 1942, and it has its head office in Ahmedabad, India.

INSECTICID.NS.d: Insecticides (India) Limited manufactures and sells agro chemicals, pesticides, and technical products for agriculture purposes in India and internationally. The company offers insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and PGRs and bio fertilizers. It also provides household, technical, and bulk products. The company sells its products through a network of approximately 5000 distributors and 60000 retailers under the Tractor brand name. Insecticides (India) Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Delhi, India.

IRBINVIT-IV.NS.d: IRB INVIT Fund is an infrastructure investment trust in India. The fund invests in a portfolio of operational road infrastructure assets. IRB InvIT Fund is managed by IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited and aims to provide stable and predictable returns to its unitholders.

ITCHOTELS.NS.d: ITC Hotels Ltd. owns, operates and manages hotels and resorts in India and internationally under brands including ITC Hotels, Mementos, Storii, Welcomhotel, Fortune and WelcomHeritage. Established in 1975, it has its principal office in Gurugram.

JISLJALEQS.NS.d: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited operates as a micro-irrigation company in India, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Hi-Tech Agri Input Products, Plastic, Agro Processing, and Other Business divisions. It provides drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, PE piping, and plumbing systems; and polyvinyl chloride pipes and pipe fittings, and EX-CEL plastic sheets.

JMFINANCIL.NS.d: JM Financial Limited provides a range of financial products and services to corporations, financial institutions, high net-worth individuals, and retail investors in India. It operates through four segments: Investment Banking, Wealth Management and Securities Business; Mortgage Lending; Distressed Credit; and Asset Management.

KIRLFER.NS.d: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries Limited manufactures and sells iron castings in India. The company supplies pig iron, including foundry, spherodized graphite, and basic grade pig iron to foundries serving the auto, engines and compressors, textile, pumps, pipes, fittings, fans, etc. through agent, dealer, and branch offices.

KRITINUT.NS.d: Kriti Nutrients Limited, established in 1992 and based in Indore, makes and distributes soybean-based goods worldwide under the Kriti brand. Its products include edible oils such as sunflower, soybean, groundnut and mustard, soya lecithin, textured soy protein, soya flour, flakes and hulls, acid oil and fatty acids. Customers include food, pharmaceutical, aquaculture, poultry and dairy industries.

LGHL.NS.d: Laxmi Goldorna House Limited, founded in 2010 and based in Ahmedabad, India, is mainly active in real estate, building residential and commercial developments throughout the country. It also has a notable presence in jewellery, making and selling gold ornaments with or without precious stones.

LORDSCHLO.NS.d: Lords Chloro Alkali Limited makes and sells caustic soda and other chemicals in India and also exports. Its products include chlorinated paraffin wax, sodium hypochlorite, hydrochloric acid, liquid chlorine, bleaching powder, hydrogen gas and caustic soda in lye and flake form, supplied to the paper, soap, dye, plastic and textile industries.

MARATHON.NS.d: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited constructs, develops, and sells commercial and residential real estate projects in India. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Mumbai, India. Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited is a subsidiary of Marathon Realty Private Limited.

MBLINFRA.NS.d: MBL Infrastructures Limited provides integrated engineering, procurement, and construction services for civil construction and infrastructure sector projects in India. The company constructs, operates, and maintains highways; executes highway and BOT; railways/metro and other infrastructure; and housing, urban, and industrial infrastructure projects. The company was formerly known as Maheshwari Brothers Limited and changed its name to MBL Infrastructures Limited in July 2006.

MOSCHIP.NS.d: MosChip Technologies Limited, established in Hyderabad in 1999, specialises in semiconductor and system design. It engineers, manufactures and markets System-on-Chip technologies and Internet of Things solutions for markets in India, North America and Asia Pacific, in Semiconductor and Software and System Design segments.

MUKKA.NS.d: Mukka Proteins Limited, based in Mangaluru, makes and supplies protein products in India and abroad. It produces fish meal, fish oil and soluble fish paste, plus insect meal and insect oil, used in feeds for animals, poultry and aquaculture and in pharmaceuticals, soap, leather tanning and paint. It exports to numerous countries.

NAGREEKEXP.NS.d: Nagreeka Exports Limited engages in manufacturing and selling cotton yarns and other various merchandise in India and internationally. The company also trades in cotton yarns and various commodities. In addition, it offers specialty yarns, such as organic, slub, normal and reverse twists, core spun, chenille, dyed/gassed/mercerized, high twist, viscose, and polyester spun yarns, as well as poly viscose, polyester cotton, and viscose cotton blends; and raw, printed, and finished fabrics.

NOIDATOLL.NS.d: Noida Toll Bridge Company Limited develops, establishes, constructs, operates, and maintains Delhi Noida toll bridge on a build-own-operate-transfer basis in India. It also provides space advertisement and offices. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Noida, India.

OPTIEMUS.NS.d: Optiemus Infracom Limited trades in mobile handsets and mobile accessories in India and internationally. The company provides Blackberry, Zen, and Kult mobile devices; OptiSafe, a technology-based personal security and safety devices; and smartphone accessories under the Molife brand names, as well as engages in booking of hotel rooms through online portal. It also rents immovable property. The company was formerly known as Akanksha Cellular Limited and changed its name to Optiemus Infracom Limited in June 2011.

ORIENTBELL.NS.d: Orient Bell Limited manufactures, trades in, and sells ceramic tiles in India and internationally. It offers vitrified, ceramic, porcelain, anti-skid, digital, double charge, cool, Nano, glazed vitrified, designer, polished glazed vitrified, forever, printed double charge, germ free, stain resistant, non-digital, highlighter, polished vitrified, double glazed vitrified, full body vitrified, and wood tiles.

PERMAGN.NS.d: Permanent Magnets Limited is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing of hard ferrite magnets. The company supplies magnets to various industries, including automotive, electronics, and consumer durables. Permanent Magnets is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

PLASTIBLEN.NS.d: Plastiblends India Limited manufactures and sells colour and additive masterbatches, and thermoplastic compounds for the plastic processing industry in India. The company's products include white, black, colour, additive, filler, and PET masterbatches, as well as conductive compounds. It serves the agriculture, appliance, automotive and transportation, healthcare and pharma, packaging, textiles, and wire and cable markets, as well as electrical, electronics, and telecommunication markets.

PODDARHOUS.NS.d: Poddar Housing and Development Limited engages in the real estate construction, development, and other related activities in India. The company was formerly known as Poddar Developers Limited and changed its name to Poddar Housing and Development Limited in January 2016. Poddar Housing and Development Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.

RADHIKAJWE.NS.d: Radhika Jeweltech Limited, based in Rajkot, India, began operating in 1987. It is a jewellery retailer selling gold, silver, platinum and diamond jewellery and ornaments from a single retail location.

RUSHIL.NS.d: Rushil Décor Limited manufactures and sells decorative laminates for use in residential, commercial, and institutional spaces in India. The company offers laminate sheets, medium density fibre boards, pre-laminated medium density fibre boards, and polyvinyl chloride boards under the Vir Laminates, Vir PVC, Signor, Vir MDF, Vir prelam, and Vir HDFWR brands. The company also exports its products internationally. Rushil Décor Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

SALONA.NS.d: Salona Cotspin Limited produces and sells cotton textile products in India. The company offers cotton, blended, ring spin, open end, slub, hank, and compact yarn products, as well as knitted fabrics and apparels. It also provides grey, dyed, and printed fabrics. The company also exports its yarns and fabrics to Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Hong Kong, South Korea, Germany, Mexico, South America, Russia, etc. Salona Cotspin Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Coimbatore, India.

SHILPAMED.NS.d: Shilpa Medicare Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (API's), intermediates, and formulations in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally.. It offers API's for oncology and other therapeutic areas; and new drug delivery systems, peptides/biotech products, specialty chemicals, etc.

SIEMENS.NS.d: Siemens Limited, a Mumbai-based subsidiary of Siemens Aktiengesellschaft, was established in 1867 and operated as Siemens India Limited until its rebranding in March 1987. The company is a key global and domestic producer and purveyor of various electrical and mechanical equipment, including electric motors, generators, transformers, and systems for electricity distribution and control, alongside general-purpose machinery.

SINTEX.NS.d: Sintex Industries Limited manufactures and sells textiles and yarns in India and internationally. The company offers fabrics in various blends, including metallic yarn, silk yarn, mélange yarn, linen, modal, nylon-viscose, and cupro, as well as a range of weaves, such as dobbies, jacquards, leno, double beam and double ereel, and others; and men's/women's apparel and furnishings under the BVM brand.

SUMEETINDS.NS.d: Sumeet Industries Limited manufactures and sells yarns in India. The company provides polyester chips, partially oriented yarns, fully draw yarns, polyester texturized yarns, and carpet yarns. It also exports its products to Egypt, Saudi Arabia, China, Argentina, Poland, Portugal, Morocco, Columbia, Bangladesh, Russia, Ethiopia, Mexico, Nepal, Brazil, Peru, Algeria, Thailand, the United States, Singapore, Turkey, etc.

SWARNSAR.NS.d: Swarnsarita Gems Limited is an Indian company involved in the business of trading and manufacturing of gems and jewelry. The company deals in various precious and semi-precious stones, as well as gold and diamond jewelry. They are based in India.

ZYDUSLIFE.NS.d: Zydus Lifesciences Limited, founded in Ahmedabad in 1952 as Cadila Healthcare Limited and renamed in February 2022, is an Indian pharmaceutical and consumer goods company operating globally. It covers research, manufacturing, marketing and distribution of medicines, selling in India, the United States, Europe, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Africa.
